## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
Run “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” between other work, with all eight steps performed in order, one at a time.
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
Never seed or write into frozen `billing_v1`; the active schema is `billing_v3`.

## Current objective
Optimize billing tests and complete the paused reindex; dunning repair and router splitting are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Production cluster is `yellow`; alias `orders`; source `orders_v1`; target `orders_v2`; `id` is `keyword`; both contain 18,432 documents. `billing_v1` is superseded for writes.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorators resend emails and are forbidden. A separate UTF-8 writer is unnecessary because `ledgerly/io/text_writer.py` exists.

## Plan and progress
Reindex steps 1–5 are done; 6–8 remain pending. Exact next command: `mypy ledgerly/billing/ledger.py` (not yet run; status unknown).

## Recent work
Reduced the suite from 42.18s to 16.63s using shared factories, fixtures, and a frozen clock. Latest invoice run: 46 passed in 2.77s. Full suite: 318 passed, 4 skipped. One credit-after-refund failure remains.
